fixture_ideas.then: Keep original header, record independently resolved commit and canonical tree, compare path/mode/type/blob identities; do not report a code delta merely because the header differs from root tree.

fixture_ideas.given: Actor A privately observes claim c at sequence9/world_time20 with occurred_at5; B shares a party but is not an observer.
fixture_ideas.when: A queries time10; B queries actor/party views at time20.
fixture_ideas.then: Neither query reveals c; occurrence backdating does not backdate acquisition and party membership alone does not disclose private claims.
